notes: Falsifiable structural claims about autonomous trucking ROI in oilfield / dispersed-well contexts. Every claim has a measurable threshold and a falsifier: a single piece of evidence sufficient to flip the verdict.

claims.statement: Autonomous trucking ROI requires fixed depot-to-destination geometry.
claims.falsifier: working autonomous deployment on routes with >20% variance

claims.statement: Wellsite labor (pump ops, terrain navigation, equipment maintenance) is not automated by haul automation.
claims.threshold: driver hours per delivery unchanged or increased post-automation
claims.falsifier: documented end-to-end automation including pump operation at variable sites

claims.statement: Infrastructure precondition capex exceeds vehicle capex for dispersed small wells.
claims.threshold: paving + marking + receiving infrastructure > $500k per route-mile
claims.falsifier: cost data showing dispersed-well infrastructure < vehicle fleet cost

claims.statement: ROI window must exceed well productivity decline curve.
claims.threshold: lease productive life > equipment depreciation period (typ. 7yr)

claims.statement: Equipment resale value to non-consolidated operators approaches zero.

claims.threshold: marketing claims do not distinguish haul / navigation / site-work
claims.falsifier: scope-honest deployment language in primary sources

claims.statement: Threat-narrative deployment correlates with wage suppression, not efficiency gain.
claims.threshold: wages decline >10% in automated regions without productivity match
claims.falsifier: wage data showing parity or increase post-automation

claims.statement: Driver-performed condition monitoring is unpriced infrastructure.
tasks: mid-shift fluid checks (oil, coolant, washer, DEF)
claims.threshold: replacement cost = sensor array + diagnostic AI + intervention dispatch
claims.falsifier: deployed system showing <2x cost of driver-performed monitoring

claims.statement: Sensor replacement of human monitoring introduces new failure modes.
failure_modes: maintenance dispatch lag vs. immediate driver action
claims.falsifier: documented parity in catch rates for subtle/precursor failures

claims.statement: Roadside breakdown cost scales nonlinearly without operator present.
Driver-mediated interfaces (fuel, customer, dispatch, maintenance, regulatory, roadside) are unpriced flexibility that must be replaced.
claims.threshold: total interface replacement cost across all touchpoints
claims.falsifier: autonomous deployment with documented interface coverage at <2x driver-mediated cost

claims.statement: Autonomous deployments shift energy cost off-vehicle into remote diagnostic / dispatch / customer service infrastructure not counted in vehicle TCO.
claims.threshold: off-vehicle energy + staffing cost > 30% of total operating cost
claims.falsifier: audited TCO showing remote operations < 10% of total

claims.statement: Driver adaptation across novel fault modes is unpriced general-purpose problem-solving.
claims.falsifier: documented autonomous system handling >80% of historical driver exceptions
